- **Other TCC-protected resources:** Siri acts as an intermediary to many TCC-protected resources (e.g., Contacts, Calendars, Reminders, Location, Messages, Photos) to fulfill user requests. An application with this 'private' entitlement could potentially leverage Siri to access or manipulate these resources indirectly, potentially bypassing direct TCC prompts that a third-party app would face.
